module.purpose: Resolves a user's role within a group by querying the sync-worker database, returning null when identifiers are absent or membership is not found.
module.summary: This utility provides the sync-worker counterpart to role resolution used by mutators. It validates the user and group identifiers, queries the group membership table for the member role, and normalizes both missing membership and missing role values to null. Callers can pass the result into authorization checks.
module.businessContext: Supports group membership authorization for collaborative application resources. Failure can incorrectly deny access or make role-based permissions unavailable.

import { DB, Role } from '@tldraw/dotcom-shared'
import { Kysely } from 'kysely'

units.name: getRole
units.source:
*/
export async function getRole(
	db: Kysely<DB>,
	userId: string | null | undefined,
	groupId: string | null | undefined
): Promise<Role | null> {
	if (!userId || !groupId) return null
	const member = await db
		.selectFrom('group_user')
		.select('role')
		.where('groupId', '=', groupId)
		.where('userId', '=', userId)
		.executeTakeFirst()
	return member?.role ?? null

postconditions: If userId or groupId is falsy, the function resolves to null without querying the database.
Otherwise, the function resolves to the matching group_user.role value when a matching groupId and userId record exists.
If no matching membership exists, the function resolves to null.
invariants: The lookup requires both groupId and userId to match the same group_user record.
Only the role column is selected from the matching membership record.
edgeCases: A null, undefined, or empty-string userId causes an immediate null result.
A null, undefined, or empty-string groupId causes an immediate null result.
When the query returns no row, the result is null.
When the matching row has a nullish role, the result is null.
